title: Paragraph-gap audit: frozen public measurement and calibration protocol
statement: The plan and executable are frozen before the audit, Monte Carlo sensitivity and new word-null calibration outcomes. Published observations and original calibration summaries are already known and are replication targets.
check: Run the complete27-case synthetic calibration and the independent paragraph/line word-null audit on public practice data.

plan.scope: Public practice pages only. Independently audit the existing measurement and reproduce the complete published synthetic calibration before suggesting a hidden-page fact.
plan.selection: Use the intersection of nonempty paragraph-line locus IDs whose words contain only acdefghiklmnopqrsty in both ZL and Takahashi practice evaluation pages. Keep original page/run order; paragraph flags and omitted paragraph lines break runs. Ignore non-paragraph lines.
plan.metric: For each run, count raw EVA positions in the space-joined word sequence, derive consecutive-hit differences, and center by the mean of all gaps in that run. At lag h retain a run only if number of gaps > h+1. Pool crossproducts and squared centered endpoints across runs; divide pooled crossproduct by sqrt(pooled squared endpoints). Require at least 25 eligible pairs for a lag. Average lags1..5 defined in the observed and all null draws.
plan.primary: EVA o, within original paragraph runs, mean lags1..5, one-sided exceedance against intact-word shuffling separately within each run, no change to run order.
plan.replication: Reproduce bench.py --observe at 99 permutations and the published 27 synthetic scenarios: rates0.160,0.124,0.036; all9 scenarios in original order; 64 books,99 permutations per case, seed19026011 with original scenario-index SeedSequence. Compare each published rejection count and rounded calibration summaries. Benchmark source SHA256 must be7fdadf75a4790f458be50373a69afbbd48ed6409c3729114e709b8eaa318d12a.
plan.independent_audit: Build matched runs and compute centered gap moments independently with standard-library explicit pairs and fsum. Compare metrics and pair counts to the NumPy benchmark and merged vs.gaps implementation; use identical shuffled orders to audit tail ranks.
plan.monte_carlo_sensitivity: For the primary o measurement, run 999 intact-word permutations with each of seeds408,19026011,28027 in both editions; report observed values, null means, excesses, tail counts and plus-one p-values. These are robustness RNG repeats on the same observed text, not independent studies. Do not choose a seed or threshold based on its result.
plan.r_diagnostic: Keep r lag20 separate. Reproduce published page-versus-paragraph pair counts and descriptive p-values at99 permutations. Do not interpret sparse within-paragraph support as proof of no recurrence. No new r significance claim.
plan.synthetic_interpretation: Report all rate-shift false rejections and explicit lag20-copy power cases. Treat the fixed 11..40 average and point lag20 as different estimands. Do not replace missing power by a broad negative conclusion.
plan.negative_word_order_controls: Use 32 primary-layout null books per edition made by independent intact-word run shuffling, seed991307 with book-index seed; assess each with99 new intact-word permutations from seed55201+book_index. Report empirical rejection counts at<=0.05, with paired editions and reused layouts noted. This is an additional audit of the actual word-null measurement, distinct from hit-slot synthetic calibration.
plan.stop_rule: No symbol, band, score, selected lines, permutation count or seed selection based on outcomes. A mismatch is reported and traced, not hidden by altered parameters. No manuscript hidden pages or seed are accessed.
plan.submission: One step experiment with data, full reproduction code, input/output hashes and limitations. No hidden-page fact is submitted in this audit because the corresponding conditional gap/word-null primitive is not yet in the fact DSL.
plan.secondary_line_null: Additionally shuffle intact words separately within each original retained line, preserving line lengths, line word stocks and line/run order. Use the same999 permutation counts and seeds408,19026011,28027 for EVA o. Treat this as a separately declared descriptive sensitivity control; do not replace the primary paragraph-word null after outcomes.
